source.name: MLB.com / Pittsburgh Pirates press release: Pirates and PNC Bank announce ballpark naming rights extension
source.note: Club press release, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2022-01-25 because the live mlb.com page blocks scripts. Ten-year extension of the PNC Park naming rights.
source.quote: The Pittsburgh Pirates and PNC Bank today announced a 10-year extension to their current agreement, the centerpiece of which is the continued naming rights of PNC Park.

note: Ballpark naming rights: PNC Park. The release says the original 20-year naming-rights agreement was set to expire prior to the 2021 season and that PNC Park opened on April 9, 2001, so the naming rights began in 2001; this 2021 release announces a 10-year extension, and the value was not disclosed.
